_readme: Full pre-change capture of university_programs.language_of_instruction for the 95 rows identified as carrying raw research-hedge prose instead of a clean production value (see docs/handoffs/ingestion-staging-2026-08-21-report.md and the ORYN multi-agent coordination reconciliation exchange, 2026-08-21). Captured immediately before the corrective UPDATE that nulls these 95 rows' language_of_instruction column, per the coordinator's explicit condition: 'Capture the current values first (dump them to a file on your branch) so nothing is unrecoverable.' Selection query: WHERE lower(language_of_instruction) LIKE any of ('%unconfirmed%', '%left explicitly%', '%left as an explicit%', '%left unknown%', '%not confirmed either way%', '%no per-program%', '%no separate per-program%', '%not resolved%', '%dutch track exists but%'). Breakdown: Eindhoven University of Technology (11), Leiden University (69), University of Twente (15) = 95.
